chart.description: Average duration of PUT operations per instance in milliseconds
chart.name: PUT durations (ms)
chart.programText:
A = data('objects_durations_ms_sum', filter=filter('operation', 'put')).sum(by=['service.instance.id']).publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('objects_durations_ms_count', filter=filter('operation', 'put')).sum(by=['service.instance.id']).publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (A/B).publish(label='C')

chart.description: Counts of vector index operations performed organized by operation type and instance ID
chart.name: Vector index operations
chart.programText:
A = data('vector_index_operations', filter=filter('operation', 'create')).sum(by=['service.instance.id']).publish(label='A')
B = data('vector_index_operations', filter=filter('operation', 'delete')).sum(by=['service.instance.id']).publish(label='B')
C = (A-B).publish(label='C')
